title: last night i went to the restaurant and it had a name
content: last night when i was dreaming, i went to the restaurant in the beach town, the one near the haunted house. (if you don’t know what im talking about i drew a map you can look at it) i think its an italian restaurant. i learned that the name of it was something like “rizzo” “razzos” of course i couldn’t remember it when i woke up. has anyone else came across this restaurant? do you know the name of it?
